## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is rebased on the latest `main`.
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:` prefix, single line, English, no co-author trailers).
- [ ] Code builds and tests pass locally (`⌘+U` in Xcode).
- [ ] No new compiler warnings introduced.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased] → Added`.
- [ ] README / docs updated if the feature changes user-facing behavior.
